checks.evidence: Compose r s a c is ∃ b, r a b ∧ s b c, and Converse swaps its two arguments. Identity relations use equality, with no functional or total interpretation imposed.
The contract allows four distinct universe-polymorphic types and arbitrary heterogeneous relations, endpoints a/d, and existential intermediate points b/c.
No totality, functionality, reflexivity, or transitivity is assumed for the component relations. The associativity theorem is an unconditional logical equivalence.
JL033 independently expands both nested relation compositions as nested existentials, preserving the order r then s then t; only parentheses change.

The two proof directions unpack and repack the same b,c witnesses and the same three edge proofs. Converse composition reverses the order, and equality-unit helpers transport along the equality witness in the appropriate direction.
